name: ModelVariant117_HandleRequest
evidence: matching model_variant/variant117_entry.c: the image entry at base + 4 (eight textured sprites fly out from a model part on looping timers, a beam of quads then grows from the part towards the camera axis, and two spinning squares pulse at the end); for a non-negative request it sets the effect up from the command row indexed by the request, otherwise it runs one frame; Model_UpdateSlotControl calls the variant at base + 4 with the request modulo 1000 and then -1 (notes/model-structures.md)
notes: Shared name bound per image in *_symbols.txt instead of a #define remap; the French header-134/264 images build the same source unchanged, at the same addresses; only the resident call targets differ. HandleRequest names only the request dispatch, not the effect. See notes/overlays/model-variants.md#per-image-symbol-bindings.
